payload.core_mechanism_summary: Simulates a greedy spiral path by maintaining and shrinking a bounding box (min/max row/col) as two pointers, moving straight until hitting obstacle or boundary, then turning right.
payload.rationale: The algorithm uses four boundaries that are progressively tightened, akin to two-pointer technique, to greedily cover cells. Sorting obstacles is only to find the next stop, not the main mechanism.
